anchors.anchor: GUI cannot generate a GDML run package
anchors.actual: - `template = gdml` imports a GDML file through `G4GDMLParser` (`[gdml]/file`, `validate`, `sensitive_volumes`, `bias_volumes`; export with `/AIHL/geometry/exportGDML`) when Geant4 is built with GDML support; without it the configuration is rejected before any geometry object is built. The import does not preserve world/replica/parameterised physical-volume names or per-copy materials, and the GUI cannot generate a GDML run package (external runs can use one).
- STL import is available as the experimental `shape = tessellated`; the reader requires a closed, consistently oriented manifold (see [docs/中文几何配置说明.md](docs/中文几何配置说明.md)).

- Multi-thread CSV output uses per-worker `OutputManager` / `ScoringManager` instances and writes `_tN` files; per-thread CSV files still need an explicit merge (`scripts/merge_outputs.py` or `mergeHistograms`). With `[output]/format = root` (or `both`) G4AnalysisManager merges histograms and ntuples into one ROOT file per run, so ROOT output needs no manual merge.

anchors.anchor: 退出码为 0 不等于模拟成功
anchors.actual: 运行页会同时显示进程退出码和模拟结果。退出码为 0 不等于模拟成功：只有本次新生成的 `run_summary.txt` 证实后端和 macro 完成、至少执行一个 run、每轮计划事件全部完成且逐轮合计与摘要总数一致时才显示“模拟成功”。仅配置检查（dry-run）、交互会话结束但未运行、正常退出但无 run 会单独标记；停止、强制结束、摘要缺失或旧摘要不会被历史页误判为成功。历史页对旧版状态文件缺少摘要新鲜度证据的条目保守显示“结果未证实”。
